verdict.rationale: gstack's core is a set of skills and tooling that users install and run on their own machines. The evidence shows global or vendored installs (gstack-docs-7, gstack-docs-49), a git-clone-and-copy install model (gstack-comm-2), and dev mode that reads skills straight from a local checkout (gstack-docs-16). It also ships its own headless Chromium daemon (gstack-docs-14), keeps learnings in local ~/.gstack files (gstack-docs-17), and lets users opt out of telemetry (gstack-comm-3). missing for 10: explicit self-hosting or open-source license documentation, clarity on independence from third-party hosted agent/LLM backends, independent hands-on corroboration of a fully local deployment.
